lines.1: 「The petitions show a complaint. It is a dispute between the Go Club and the Competitive Karuta Club.」
lines.3: 「Yes. I will look into it while making my rounds of the club building.」
lines.4: Otome headed out, eager to get to work.
lines.5: 「Otome's the dependable big-sister type. She's good at mediating disputes like this.」
lines.7: 「The disputes in the club building never end. We might want to consider rearranging the rooms next year.」
lines.8: 「Hmm. Put together a report. Decision numbers 2, 8, 19, 21, 31, 42, and 52 or thereabouts dealt with petitions like these.」
lines.9: 「While you're at it, make a definitive list of every club's president, vice-president, secretary, and treasurer. Those records are a mess.」
lines.10: 「The activities and advisers for each society are another problem. It's nice to have so many, but apparently some of them are ghost clubs.」
lines.11: 「Sure. I'll have the list ready in no time.」
lines.12: Yoshimi rapidly sorted through the documents.
lines.17: Fukahire put them in the fridge as if it were the most natural thing in the world.
lines.18: Something was wrong. It was wrong that this didn't feel wrong.
lines.20: 「Let's see... Boards for the debate tournament, among other things. We'll have to go to the home improvement store.」
lines.21: 「Then, Fukahire, take a look at Yoppi's memo and buy everything on it.」
lines.22: He was an errand boy. Nothing but an errand boy.
lines.25: 「Get a receipt from the Ryuumeikan executive committee. The school will pay for it, of course.」
lines.28: 「Hahaha! They really need me around here. Sorry, man. Try not to get jealous.」
lines.30: 「Women should be the ones serving men, but at times like this, a man has to show some kindness too.」
